verdict.rationale: The Python SDK's qna_search returns a direct answer to a query in one call, which the repo describes as getting "accurate and concise answers to questions, in one line of code" (tavily-gh-5, tavily-gh-10). The Research endpoint also runs multiple searches, analyzes sources and generates a report (tavily-docs-26), with streaming available (tavily-docs-29); its results can also be fetched later by request ID (tavily-docs-28). missing for 10: no explicit evidence that qna_search answers come with source citations or are LLM-generated, no documentation of an answer field on the core Search endpoint, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
